name: What is a multigenerational living suite?
description: A multigenerational living suite is a self-contained living space on the same property as a primary home, designed for extended family.

mainEntity.name: What is a multigenerational living suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: A multigenerational living suite, often called an accessory dwelling unit (ADU), is a self-contained living space within or attached to a primary home, or a separate structure on the same property. It typically includes a bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen, allowing family members to live independently while remaining close. The design can range from a converted garage to a newly constructed detached unit, tailored to the specific needs of the residents.
acceptedAnswer.description: A multigenerational living suite is a self-contained living space on the same property as a primary home, designed for extended family.
